name: prepare_draft
description: Prepares and saves a draft objection summary for the caller's own use, from facts confirmed in the read back. It does not send, submit or file anything anywhere. Returns the summary text and a case reference.

area.description: Dubai area or community exactly as the caller confirmed it in the read back, for example Deira, Dubai Marina, Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC) or Al Barsha. Pass the caller's words; English or Arabic is fine.

unit_type.description: Unit type as confirmed in the read back, for example studio or 1 bedroom. English or Arabic is fine.

current_rent_aed.description: Current annual rent in UAE dirhams as a plain number with no commas or currency, as confirmed in the read back.

renewal_date.description: Calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD format. The date the current lease contract ends. Only include if the caller gave it and confirmed it.

notice_received_date.description: Calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD format. The date the caller received notice of the rent change. Only include if the caller gave it and confirmed it.

proposed_rent_aed.description: The new annual rent the landlord proposed, in UAE dirhams as a plain number, only if the caller gave it and confirmed it.
